title: Something in the Cellar
description: Mara has lost a week of stores to whatever is living under the Golden Flagon. She wants it gone. She has not asked why it came.

into_the_cellar.title: Go down to the cellar
into_the_cellar.objective: Deal with whatever is eating the Flagon's stores. Go down to the cellar, then come back up and tell Mara when it's quiet.
into_the_cellar.journal: Something in Mara Hearthstone's cellar is eating her grain. She'd rather see it dead than hear an explanation.

the_grain.title: Find out what drew them
the_grain.objective: The rats came for something. Find out what by examining the four sacks along the cellar's north wall, then bring your findings to Mara.
the_grain.journal: The rats aren't nesting in the cellar. They're commuting to it. Four sacks of spoiled grain are stacked against the north wall, and none belong to Mara. Each bears a second mark under the granary stamp, burnt into the hessian: a plumb-bob hanging inside a square. That mark isn't the granary's.

exterminated.title: Cellar cleared
exterminated.journal: I killed the rats. Mara paid me and swept up. She'll lose the stores again in a month. Neither of us said so.

source_found.title: The spoiled grain
source_found.journal: The rats came for four sacks of rotted grain nobody at the Flagon ordered. The tally stick with them bears the granary reeve's stamp. Hollis Marrow is dumping grain he was paid for but never delivered.
